 This Petition, Coming On For Order

ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE G BASAVARAJA  ORAL ORDER Heard arguments on both sides.

2. This petition is filed by the petitioner/accused no.1 under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023 seeking to grant anticipatory bail in Crime No.127/2024 of Halagur Police Sation, Mandya District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498-A, 504,
323 and 506 r/w.34 of IPC.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the alleged offences are not punishable either with death or imprisonment for life but the learned Sessions Judge has rejected the application filed on behalf of the present petitioner.

4. On perusal of the FIR, it would reveal that on the basis of complaint filed by one Rekha H S,
Halaguru police NC: 2024:KHC:41242 have registered the case in Crime No.127/2024 against accused for commission of offences punishable under Sections 498-A, 504, 323 and 506 r/w.34 of IPC.
The alleged offences are not punishable with death penalty or imprisonment for life.
Accused 2 to 4 have already been enlarged on bail by the learned Sessions Judge, Mandya.

5. Considering the nature and gravity of offences, antecedents of the present petitioner and on the principle of parity, I am of the considered view that it is just and proper to allow the petition and release the accused on bail by imposing conditions.
Hence, I proceed to pass the following.

ORDER (1) Criminal petition is allowed;
(2) The petitioner/accused no.1 shall be released on bail on execution of self-bond for Rs.50,000/-
with one surety for the likesum in the event of his arrest in Crime NC: 2024:KHC:41242 No.127/2024 of Halagur Police Sation, Mandya District subject to following conditions :
i) Petitioner/Accused no.1 shall assist the investigating officer and shall be available as and when required for investigation.
ii) He shall not tamper the prosecution witnesses in any manner.
Sd/-
